column1: # fm-lint-baseline.tsv - the committed ShellCheck baseline for this repository.
# file then code. bin/fm-lint.sh collects the diagnostics; bin/fm-lint-ratchet.sh
# owns this format, the comparison, and the update.
# The ratchet only ratchets down: bin/fm-lint.sh --update-baseline refuses to
# record a new diagnostic, so this count can never grow. A new diagnostic has
# to be fixed in the source first.
